title: Austin Annexation Public Hearing
summary:
*   A special public hearing was held to discuss significant land annexation within the Austin area.
*   The primary focus of the meeting was the proposed annexation of the North Central Austin Growth Corridor Municipal Utility District (MUD).
*   In addition to the MUD, four other outlying parcels of land were also under consideration for annexation.
*   The session allowed for public input regarding these expansions of city limits, which would impact future services and governance for the affected areas.
